title: SelmaSpecContract
description: Front-matter schema for every YAML file under docs/spec/contracts/ (except optional nested maps). Ensures investigation-stable ownership and versioning aligned with C4.

contract_id.description: Dotted domain id, e.g. directive.lifecycle, data_stores.directives_store

schema_version.description: SemVer of this contract document body

design_contract_version.description: Stamp of the design freeze line. MUST equal docs/standards/VERSION (enforced by scripts/check_design_alignment.py). Not an independent per-contract version.

owner_component.description: C4 component/repository ID, certification_tool, or null for meta

owner.description: Legacy alias for meta contracts only; prefer owner_component

c4_refs.description: Optional list of related C4 IDs for multi-owner concerns
